newsitem.title: USA: AmeriCredit stake upped by Regan group.
newsitem.headline: AmeriCredit stake upped by Regan group.

text.p: A group led by Regan Partners L.P. said Tuesday it raised its stake in AmeriCredit Corp to 2,589,300 common shares or 8.9 percent from 7.9 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 341,100 common shares between February 25 and March 31 at prices ranging from $17.003 to $19.436 per share.
AmeriCredit Corp, based in Fort Worth, Tx., is a consumer finance company specializing in financing auto sales and contracts.
